$comment: Model registry for the universal router. Data only: add models, prices and provider ids here or in .forge/models.json. Prices are USD per million tokens and are used only for models without observed attempt costs. `providers` maps a provider name (as in providers.js) to the id that provider serves; an empty map means the model is recommended by id but cannot be applied until you add a provider id.
